[element-term-source]
=== `<term-source>` Term Source Elements

Origin of the term described in a <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>> element inside a terms and definitions section.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>> (default = en)

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>>, <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>>
#### Description

Any combination of: Text, numbers, or special characters External Linking Elements <<element-email,`<email>`>> <<element-email,Email Address>> <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-uri,`<uri>`>> <<element-uri,Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)>> Emphasis Elements <<element-bold,`<bold>`>> <<element-bold,Bold>> <<element-fixed-case,`<fixed-case>`>> <<element-fixed-case,Fixed Case>> <<element-italic,`<italic>`>> <<element-italic,Italic>> <<element-monospace,`<monospace>`>> <<element-monospace,Monospace Text (Typewriter Text)>> <<element-num,`<num>`>> <<element-num,ISO Numeric Emphasis>> <<element-overline,`<overline>`>> <<element-overline,Overline>> <<element-roman,`<roman>`>> <<element-roman,Roman>> <<element-ruby,`<ruby>`>> <<element-ruby,Ruby Wrapper>> <<element-sans-serif,`<sans-serif>`>> <<element-sans-serif,Sans Serif>> <<element-sc,`<sc>`>> <<element-sc,Small Caps>> <<element-strike,`<strike>`>> <<element-strike,Strike Through>> <<element-underline,`<underline>`>> <<element-underline,Underline>> Inline Display Elements <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>> <<element-inline-code,Inline Code>> <<element-inline-graphic,`<inline-graphic>`>> <<element-inline-graphic,Inline Graphic>> <<element-inline-media,`<inline-media>`>> <<element-inline-media,Inline Media Object>> <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> <<element-private-char,Private Character (Custom or Unicode)>> Baseline Change Elements <<element-sub,`<sub>`>> <<element-sub,Subscript>> <<element-sup,`<sup>`>> <<element-sup,Superscript>>
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  term-source  (#PCDATA %term-source-elements;)*            >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA | email | ext-link | uri | bold | fixed-case | italic | monospace | num | overline | roman | sans-serif | sc | strike | underline | ruby | inline-graphic | private-char | inline-code | inline-media | sub | sup)*

#### Tagged Sample

##### With definition to qualify a term
[source,xml]
....
...
<term-sec>
 <label>3.16</label>
 <term-display>
  <term>consensus</term>
  <def>
   <p>general agreement, characterized by the absence of sustained opposition 
    to substantial issues by any important part of the concerned interests and 
    by a process that involves seeking to take into account the views of all
    parties concerned and to reconcile any conflicting arguments</p>
  </def>
  <non-normative-note>
   <p>Consensus need not imply unanimity.</p>
  </non-normative-note>
  <term-source>ISO/IEC Guide 2:2004, definition 1.7</term-source>
 </term-display>
</term-sec>
...
....
